aboutGame.title: What is Animal Crossing New Leaf?
paragraphs: Animal Crossing New Leaf is Nintendo's cozy life-simulation game for the Nintendo 3DS. You step off the train expecting a quiet vacation and are immediately mistaken for the new mayor, inheriting a house loan, a desk at Town Hall, and a neighborhood of animal villagers who remember everything you do.

From there the town grows at your own pace: fish and catch bugs, donate finds to Blathers at the museum, decorate your home, plant orchards, design paths and clothing, and unlock shops along Main Street. The Welcome amiibo update later added amiibo card support, the campground, and crossover campers, so a single save file can keep expanding for years.

modules.name: Animal Crossing New Leaf Beginner Guide
modules.description: New mayors start here: Rover's train questions, choosing one of four town maps, your first house loan, and the daily routine that keeps a town running.

highlights.detail: Answer Rover's train questions, which set your character's face, gender, and the four town maps he offers.
Pick a map with a central Town Hall, Re-Tail near a beach ramp, a gentle river, and two beach ramps.
Meet Isabelle at Town Hall and work through her living advice tasks to earn your first tools.
Gather native fruit and shells to pay the 10,000 Bell tent down payment to Tom Nook.
After your second home loan, Kapp'n ferries you to Tortimer Island for year-round beetle farming.
Settle into a routine: water flowers, hit the money rock, dig fossils, and talk to every villager.

modules.name: Animal Crossing New Leaf Villagers Guide
modules.description: Meet the animal neighbors, understand the eight personality types, and learn how campsite visitors, amiibo cards, and move-out requests shape your roster.

highlights.label: Roster
highlights.detail: 333 animal villagers exist, but only ten can live in town at once and five arrive when you start.

highlights.label: Types
highlights.detail: Eight personalities drive every conversation, including Smug and Uchi, which both debuted in New Leaf.

highlights.label: Camping
highlights.detail: The campsite and Welcome amiibo cards let you invite a specific villager instead of waiting on chance.

highlights.label: Moving
highlights.detail: Villagers ask to leave on a cycle, so friendship built through mail and errands keeps favorites in town.

modules.name: Animal Crossing New Leaf Items Guide
modules.description: Browse furniture sets, clothing, tools, and collectibles, with notes on where each item comes from and how it fits into your catalog.

highlights.label: Furniture
highlights.detail: Full furniture series plus wallpapers and floorings, with the orderable and unorderable split explained.

highlights.label: Clothing
highlights.detail: Shirts, dresses, hats, and accessories from Able Sisters, including premium Gracie fashion checks.

highlights.label: Tools
highlights.detail: Silver and Golden rods, nets, axes, and shovels unlock through museum donations and town milestones.

highlights.label: Catalog
highlights.detail: Re-order anything you have owned from the catalog and track the daily rotating shop stock.

modules.name: Animal Crossing New Leaf Fish and Bugs Guide
modules.description: Track every fish, bug, and diving catch by season, time, and location, and see which species are worth chasing for Bells or a museum donation.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Coelacanth, Golden Stag, and other rare catches that anchor a full pocket of Bells.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Sharks and palm-tree beetles that reliably pay for house and town upgrades.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Common river and ocean catches that fill the museum while funding early projects.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Everyday butterflies, moths, and small fish that are easy early catalog entries.

modules.name: Animal Crossing New Leaf QR Codes
modules.description: Scan, save, and share custom designs for clothing, paths, and town flags using the Able Sisters sewing machine and your 3DS camera.

highlights.label: Pro Design
highlights.detail: Scan a 32x32 pattern and wear it as a shirt, dress, or coat around town.

highlights.label: Pattern
highlights.detail: Save standard patterns to wear, drop as ground decor, or set as the town flag.

highlights.label: Path Tile
highlights.detail: Place scanned ground patterns to build walkways and plazas across your town.

highlights.label: Umbrella
highlights.detail: Carry a scanned umbrella design on rainy days for a custom look.

modules.name: Animal Crossing New Leaf Amiibo Guide
modules.description: Use amiibo figures and Welcome amiibo cards to invite crossover campers, earn MEOW Coupons, and unlock campground furniture.

highlights.label: Welcome
highlights.detail: The 2016 Welcome amiibo update added the campground, Wisp, and amiibo card support to New Leaf.

highlights.label: Campers
highlights.detail: Scanning a figure or card summons a specific villager to the campground to visit or move in.

highlights.label: Coupons
highlights.detail: Daily campground requests pay MEOW Coupons, which buy exclusive furniture and rare items.

highlights.label: Figures
highlights.detail: Crossover campers such as Epona, Inkwell, and Ganon appear only through their matching amiibo.

modules.name: Animal Crossing New Leaf Town Design Guide
modules.description: Plan paths, bridges, Public Works Projects, ordinances, and house exteriors so your layout stays walkable and easy to decorate.

highlights.label: PWPs
highlights.detail: Public Works Projects add bridges, benches, lamps, and cafes, each costing 20,000 Bells or more.

highlights.label: Ordinances
highlights.detail: Beautiful Town, Early Bird, Night Owl, and Bell Boom each reshape how your town runs.

highlights.label: Paths
highlights.detail: Lay ground patterns or wear natural dirt paths to guide foot traffic and protect the grass.

highlights.label: Exteriors
highlights.detail: Nook's Homes sells roofs, doors, fences, and mailboxes to customize your house outside.

modules.name: Animal Crossing New Leaf Multiplayer Guide
modules.description: Visit friends' towns locally or online, tour dream addresses, and explore Tortimer Island together with minigames and rare catches.

highlights.detail: Open the train station gates so local or online friends can travel into your town.
Register 3DS friend codes, then promote trusted players to Best Friend for easy repeat visits.
Host or visit a town to shop, tour, and trade while the host controls who may roam.
Sail with Kapp'n to Tortimer Island for group tours, rare bugs, and sharks.
Upload a Dream Address at the Dream Suite so anyone can tour a safe snapshot of your town.
Agree on ground rules before visiting so flowers, patterns, and villagers stay safe.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Animal Crossing New Leaf.

items.question: What is Animal Crossing New Leaf?
items.answer: Animal Crossing New Leaf is a life-simulation game from Nintendo for the Nintendo 3DS. You arrive in a small town, are mistaken for its new mayor, and spend your time fishing, catching bugs, decorating your home, befriending animal villagers, and building up the town at your own pace.

items.question: How do I make Bells quickly in Animal Crossing New Leaf?
items.answer: Sell fruit, fish, and bugs at Re-Tail, then unlock Tortimer Island for year-round beetle and shark farming. The Sunday turnip stalk market and the daily money rock are also reliable Animal Crossing New Leaf income once you learn the timing.

items.question: Which villagers can live in my Animal Crossing New Leaf town?
items.answer: Animal Crossing New Leaf has 333 animal villagers across eight personality types, but only ten can live in town at once and five arrive at the start. The campsite and Welcome amiibo cards let you invite specific neighbors instead of waiting on chance.

items.question: Does Animal Crossing New Leaf have redeem codes?
items.answer: No. Animal Crossing New Leaf has no in-game code redemption system, and item IDs only work through save editors that can put your town at risk. The practical shortcuts are amiibo cards and figures, which summon villagers and campground items entirely offline.

items.question: How do I visit other towns in Animal Crossing New Leaf?
items.answer: Open the train station gates to invite friends locally or online, add Best Friends for easy repeat visits, and sail to Tortimer Island with Kapp'n. The Dream Suite also lets you upload an Animal Crossing New Leaf town snapshot for anyone to tour.
